props.text: Schedule Manager demo — EDITS ARE REAL: data.schedules is bound to the gateway's user schedules (system.user.getSchedules() + two synthetic demo shifts), and the onScheduleSave / onScheduleDelete scripts persist via system.user.editSchedule / addSchedule / removeSchedule. Drag empty grid space to paint availability, drag a block's edge to resize, click a block to remove, then Save. Delete asks twice.

config.script:
# Reference persistence: rebuild a BasicScheduleModel from the flat mirror
	# and write it to the gateway, then bump refreshTick so the binding refetches
	# and the component's dirty badge clears against the saved data.
	from com.inductiveautomation.ignition.common.user.schedule import BasicScheduleModel
	s = event.schedule
	m = BasicScheduleModel()
	m.name = str(s.name)
	m.description = str(s.description)
	m.observeHolidays = bool(s.observeHolidays)
	m.allDays = bool(s.allDays)
	for day in ['monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday', 'sunday']:
		setattr(m, day, bool(s[day]))
		setattr(m, day + 'Time', str(s[day + 'Time']))
	try:
		if str(s.name) in [str(n) for n in system.user.getScheduleNames()]:
			system.user.editSchedule(str(s.name), m)
		else:
			try:
				system.user.addSchedule(m)
			except TypeError:
				system.user.addSchedule(str(s.name), m)
		self.view.custom.lastEvent = 'onScheduleSave persisted "' + str(s.name) + '"'
	except Exception as e:
		self.view.custom.lastEvent = 'onScheduleSave FAILED: ' + str(e)
	self.view.custom.refreshTick = self.view.custom.refreshTick + 1
